title: Assumptions & Reports: ずとも, なりとも, もしないで, ものとして, ものと思われる, とされる / とみられる, ともすれば
description: Even without, at least, without even, assuming, it is thought, it is said / estimated, and apt to.

points.title: 〜ずとも: even without
points.summary: ない-stem + ずとも = even without A (formal ても…なくても).
points.body: - 言わ**ずとも**、彼の気持ちはわかる.
examples: {急|いそ}がずとも{間|ま}に{合|あ}う。
We'll make it even without hurrying.

points.title: 〜なりとも: at least, even a little
points.summary: Small amount + なりとも = even just (a little).
points.body: - 少し**なりとも**お役に立てれば幸いです.
examples: {一目|ひとめ}なりとも{会|あ}いたい。
I want to see them, if only for a moment.

points.title: 〜もしないで: without even
points.summary: ます-stem + もしないで = without even doing A (criticism).
points.body: - ろくに調べ**もしないで**文句を言う.
examples: He threw it away without even looking at it.

points.title: 〜ものとして: assuming
points.summary: Plain form + ものとして = treating it as if A (for now).
points.body: - 全員賛成した**ものとして**、話を進めます.
examples: {連絡|れんらく}がなければ、{参加|さんか}しないものとして{扱|あつか}います。
If we don't hear from you, we'll treat you as not attending.

points.title: 〜ものと思われる: it is thought that
points.summary: Plain form + ものと思われる = (news / report style) it is believed that.
points.body: - 事故の原因は運転手の居眠りによる**ものと思われる**.
examples: {犯人|はんにん}は{窓|まど}から{侵入|しんにゅう}したものと{思|おも}われる。
The culprit is believed to have got in through the window.

points.title: 〜とされる / とみられる
points.summary: とされる = it is said / regarded as (general view). とみられる = it is estimated (by observers).
points.body:
- この寺は八世紀に建てられた**とされる**.
- 死者は百人を超える**とみられる**.
examples: {死者|ししゃ}は{百人|ひゃくにん}を{超|こ}えるとみられる。
The death toll is estimated to exceed 100.

points.title: ともすれば: apt to, easily
points.summary: ともすれば (ともすると) + (unwanted) tendency = is apt to.
points.body: - 忙しいと、**ともすれば**食事がおろそかになる.
examples: {若|わか}い{人|ひと}はともすれば{無理|むり}をしがちだ。
Young people are apt to overdo it.

questions.prompt: {言|い}わ（　）、{彼|かれ}の{気持|きも}ちはわかる。
notes: もしないで attaches to the ます-stem (言いもしないで), not 言わ.
ずには needs おかない / いられない.
questions.translation: I understand how he feels without him saying a word.

questions.prompt: What does 「{急|いそ}がずとも{間|ま}に{合|あ}う。」 mean?
options: We won't make it unless we hurry.
Don't hurry or we'll be late.
We'll make it even without hurrying.

questions.prompt: {少|すこ}し（　）お{役|やく}に{立|た}てれば{幸|さいわ}いです。
questions.explanation: At least a little: **なりとも**.
notes: 少しなり alone isn't the phrase.
questions.translation: I'd be glad to be of even a little help.

questions.prompt: What does 「{一目|ひとめ}なりとも{会|あ}いたい。」 mean?
options: I don't want to see them.
I want to see them, if only for a moment.
I saw them at a glance.
questions.explanation: なりとも = **if only, at least**.

questions.prompt: {彼|かれ}はろくに{調|しら}べ（　）{文句|もんく}ばかり{言|い}う。
questions.translation: He complains without even looking into it properly.

questions.prompt: What does 「{見|み}もしないで{捨|す}てた。」 mean?
options: He looked at it, then threw it away.
He threw it where nobody could see.
He threw it away without even looking at it.

questions.prompt: {全員|ぜんいん}{賛成|さんせい}した（　）、{話|はなし}を{進|すす}めます。
notes: なりとも = 'at least (a little)' and follows an amount.
questions.translation: We'll proceed on the assumption that everyone agrees.

questions.prompt: What does 「{連絡|れんらく}がなければ、{参加|さんか}しないものとして{扱|あつか}います。」 mean?
options: Only people who contact us will be treated.
Please don't contact us if you're attending.
If you don't contact us, you can't attend.
If we don't hear from you, we'll treat you as not attending.
notes: It's an assumption, not a rule.

questions.prompt: {事故|じこ}の{原因|げんいん}は{運転手|うんてんしゅ}の{居眠|いねむ}りによる（　）。
questions.explanation: It is thought: **ものと思われる**.
questions.translation: The accident is believed to have been caused by the driver falling asleep.

questions.prompt: What does 「{犯人|はんにん}は{窓|まど}から{侵入|しんにゅう}したものと{思|おも}われる。」 mean?
options: The culprit is believed to have got in through the window.
The culprit thought about the window.
Someone thinks they saw the culprit.
The culprit definitely came through the window.
questions.explanation: ものと思われる = **it is believed**.

questions.prompt: この{寺|てら}は{八世紀|はっせいき}に{建|た}てられた（　）。
notes: とさせる isn't the phrase.
questions.translation: This temple is said to have been built in the eighth century.

questions.prompt: What does 「{死者|ししゃ}は{百人|ひゃくにん}を{超|こ}えるとみられる。」 mean?
options: The death toll is estimated to exceed 100.

questions.prompt: {忙|いそが}しいと、（　）{食事|しょくじ}がおろそかになる。
notes: ずとも follows the ない-stem (言わずとも) — it can't start a clause.
ともなく = 'without really meaning to'.
questions.translation: When you're busy, you're apt to neglect your meals.

questions.prompt: What does 「{若|わか}い{人|ひと}はともすれば{無理|むり}をしがちだ。」 mean?
options: Young people are apt to overdo it.
If young people try, it's impossible.
